# h3_eip (Data Source)

Looks up one Elastic IP by `id`, or by `name` or `ip_address` in a project. Pass its `id` to `h3_vm.eip_id` or `h3_database.eip_id` to use an address reserved outside this configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An address reserved in the console (e.g. already in DNS and firewall allow lists).
data "h3_eip" "mail" {
  ip_address = "203.0.113.25"
}

resource "h3_vm" "mail" {
  name        = "mail"
  cpu         = 2
  memory      = "4Gi"
  image       = "ubuntu:24.04"
  ssh_key_ids = [var.ssh_key_id]
  white_ip    = true
  eip_id      = data.h3_eip.mail.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) EIP ID
- `ip_address` (String) Public IPv4 address
- `name` (String) EIP name
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID)

### Read-Only

- `bound` (Boolean) True when the EIP is attached or reserved
- `bound_resource_id` (String) ID of the bound resource
- `bound_resource_type` (String) Type of the bound resource (`vm`, `db`, `lb`)
- `description` (String) EIP comment (null when not set)
- `gateway_name` (String) Gateway name in the platform
- `status` (String) EIP status (DETACHED, ATTACHED, PENDING, ERROR)
